title: Stalkwise filtered-colimit presentation of cartesian higher images
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-cartesian-higher-image-germ-vanishing, the stalkwise system of stage higher-image fibers, indexed by the opposite of I and with transition maps induced by cartesianHigherImageTransition, admits a filtered colimit cocone canonically isomorphic to the limiting higher-image fiber; the cocone legs correspond to cartesianHigherImageLeg and the diagram maps correspond to the transition maps.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.8, second proof; local affine etale cohomology continuity

proof.text: Descend an affine etale neighbourhood of the geometric point and the finite cohomology data representing a stalk section to a stage. Apply continuity of etale cohomology for the resulting qcqs affine inverse system, then transport through sheafification, inverse-image composition, and the exchange comparison to obtain the filtered-colimit cocone and its leg and transition identities.

proof_origin.place: Second proof, local affine etale cohomology continuity

theorem cartesianHigherImage_stalk_colimit
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (s : c.pt.left) :
    let G : I → AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} := fun i ↦
      ((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        (cartesianHigherImageStage D c f F q i)
    let L := ((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
      (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
      (cartesianHigherImageLimit D c f F q)
    ∃ (H : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (t : Cocone H), Nonempty (IsColimit t) ∧
      ∃ (e : ∀ i : I, H.obj (Opposite.op i) ≅ (G i)) (einf : t.pt ≅ L),
        (∀ i, t.ι.app (Opposite.op i) ≫ einf.hom =
          (e i).hom ≫
            ((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
              (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
              (cartesianHigherImageLeg D c f F q i)) ∧
        (∀ {i j : I} (a : j ⟶ i), H.map (Opposite.op a) =
          (e i).hom ≫
            ((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
              (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
              (cartesianHigherImageTransition D c f F q a) ≫
            (e j).inv)
